name: James Northcott
source:
The scion of a wealthy Northeastern family, James has never been in want of anything—except freedom from the stifling household he grew up in and the boring hometown of his youth. Taking the first opportunity he could to move to the city was one of many impulsive choices he has ever made, but every decision he makes tends to be fraught with worry and concern.

He considers Gilda his closest friend and confidant, and would do absolutely anything within his means to ensure that she is happy and well taken care of, including but not limited to making sure Gilda received an impossibly-high alimony during their divorce. James carries his heart on his sleeve, most hesitantly.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/campnellas/status/1674101402618953738]Twitter[/url]]
